items.name: *New* Gyu-Don Mentai
items.description: Indulge in our Gyu-Don Mentai, a mouth-watering rice bowl topped with tender beef, savory mentaiko sauce, and a perfectly cooked onsen egg. The caramelized onions add a touch of sweetness to balance out the flavors. Satisfy your cravings and experience the perfect blend of textures with every bite.

items.name: *New* Cheesy Breaded Salmon Rice Bowl
items.description: Indulge in the ultimate Cheesy breaded salmon dish, with a generous amount of cheese and a perfectly torched topping. Every chunk of salmon is coated in breadcrumbs and fried to perfection for maximum crispiness.
